subject: Post-call recap & proposed carousel demo windows
snippet: Thanks for the call — proposed a rotating 'carousel' of demo windows (US/EU/APAC) so coverage rotates fairly; suggested 45-minute technical deep-dive slots and attached an agenda.
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Helena Park <helena@acmetrics.com>; Mark Das <mark.das@acmetrics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed carousel demo windows

Helena / Mark — thanks again for carving out 30 minutes today. Quick recap from my side and a concrete proposal to get us to a technical deep dive: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood for latency-sensitive customer-facing features (live suggestions + document summarization).
- Key constraints: must support predictable 99th pct latencies, SOC2 evidence, and on-prem/private deployment options for certain PII flows.
- Success criteria: POC demonstrating stable sub-200ms token latency on 2k qps synthetic load + integration checklist for SSO/KMS.

Next steps I propose:
1) 45-minute technical deep dive (engineer + infra): demo of a representative flow, integration touchpoints, and SLA/observability discussion.
2) Slide + runbook share before the deep dive so your infra/security can pre-scan.
3) Calendar: to make scheduling simpler across teams in US/EU/APAC, we suggest a small pilot of rotating "carousel" demo windows — every week the meeting sits in a different timeband so the burden rotates.

Proposed carousel pattern (single recurring meeting we rotate week-to-week):
- Week 1 (US-friendly): 8:00 AM PT / 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT — 45 min
- Week 2 (EU-friendly): 11:00 AM PT / 20:00 CET / 03:00 SGT — 45 min
- Week 3 (APAC-friendly): 3:00 PM PT / 00:00 CET / 08:00 SGT — 45 min
This keeps each region getting at least one convenient window every three weeks while letting your engineers join at least one comfortable slot per month. We call it the "carousel" to emphasize fairness.

If these bands look OK, tell me which region you'd prefer for the first slot and who from your side should be on the deep dive (security, infra/ops, app lead). I attached a short agenda for the MVP deep dive. Once we agree, I'll send a calendar invite and a rotating ICS that makes the swap pattern explicit.

Att: MVP-demo-agenda.pdf (attached)

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

We like the carousel idea; fairness across EMEA/APAC/US is important since teams are distributed. For the first deep dive we prefer an EU-friendly slot so our security lead (Mark) can join without staying late.

- Tue 29 Jun: 20:00 CET (works for Mark)
- Thu 1 Jul: 16:00 CET (works if the deck is shared beforehand)

Attaching Mark in this thread — he may have additional compliance questions. Also please include an agenda and a short list of pre-reqs for our infra team.
